author: ZeroHedge
text:
Anthropic's models never 'went rogue'. They entirely followed the boundaries set by Anthropic employees. 

An Anthropic employees instructed them to exploit a target, called a flag, which shared the same name as a real company. Which it did.

A false flag attack, if you will.
